card.name: Metal compounds and kidney-toxic drugs
card.fires_on: Words right after a metal name (copper solution, cobalt salts, nickel salts), and inside names of kidney- and ear-toxic drugs such as cisplatin and aminoglycosides.

modes.label: Metal then compound word
modes.description: The word 'solution' or 'salts' directly after a metal name such as copper, cobalt or nickel.

modes.label: Inside nephrotoxic drug names
modes.description: The middle of cisplatin or aminoglycoside when the text discusses kidney or ear toxicity.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about kidneys and metals, such as 'kidneys' and 'metals'.
card.plain: It fires on metal-compound wording and on platinum or aminoglycoside drug names linked to kidney harm.
